title: Nuclear Civil Engineer Senior IB2150

title: Firefighter Technician II
descriptionText: Requisition ID: 43835 NextEra Energy Resources is one of the largest wholesale generators of electric power and renewable energy from the wind and sun in North America. Position Specific Description At NextEra Energy we have a passion for taking your career to the next level. Our talented employees are our biggest asset to continued success. If you are interested in joining a leading team for an industry leading Nuclear fleet, look no further. This role will be located at our Seabrook station site in NH. Seabrook Station is located on 900 acres on the seacoast of southern New Hampshire. The plant is operated in a highly-responsible manner and is dedicated to protecting the environment while meeting the energy needs of New England. Seabrook Station is one of only a few nuclear power plants in this country that is ISO 14001 compliant, recognizing the plant’s leadership and excellence in environmental stewardship. Below is a description of the duties you can expect in this role. In addition to the description listed below, the ideal candidate will have an understanding of energy market economics and be process improvement oriented. Start your future now, apply today! Job Overview Performs skilled work in fire prevention, saving and protection of life and property in fighting fires and other emergencies, provides emergency care to victims of fires and other accidents, inspects and tests associated fire protection equipment and facilities, and performs minor maintenance to such equipment and facilities, performs inspections for combustible storage and ignition source permits, and works as directed by the Control Room when assigned to shift coverage. Typical Duties and Responsibilities: Participates in selected training sessions as directed by the AOM Line. Participates in fire and emergency medical training and drills as directed. Performs equipment surveillance tests on fire protection systems, components and equipment as directed. Performs routine visual inspections of operating equipment, fire barriers and spaces and informs the Control Room of any abnormal conditions detected. Reviews ignition source and combustible storage permits, specifies necessary instructions and performs inspections and evaluations of the work site to ensure work is performed in accordance with Seabrook Station Fire Protection Manual requirements. Assists in the maintenance of fire brigade procedures, programs and strategies. Maintains a thorough understanding of the Station Fire Protection Program and Procedures and recommends improvements. Interprets and implements procedures relative to the use, testing and maintenance of fire protection equipment. Keeps and maintains logs and records as requested/required. Performs minor routine preventative and corrective maintenance on plant fire equipment, components or systems. Works on a rotating shift schedule as directed and maintains assigned station until properly relieved. Assists in the Fire Fighting activities in response to on-site fire emergencies. Performs strenuous physical activity in extinguishment of fire, emergency rescue, etc. Acts as responder for the Emergency Response Organization as assigned. Performs as a member of the Hazardous Material Response Team. Performs as a member of a team in confined space and technical rescues. Performs confined space entry monitoring and prepares related permits. Required to be a member of the Seabrook Station Emergency Response Organization (ERO), when assigned, and to adhere to all related requirements specified in the Seabrook Station Radiological Emergency Plan. These requirements include, but are not limited to, maintaining applicable ERO position qualifications, participation in drills and exercises, and responding to an actual emergency (including radiological). Required to participate in major outages, when assigned, by performing a designated outage position, and maintaining required training qualifications. An outage assignment may involve shiftwork and/or working extended hours outside of normal schedule. Performs other duties and responsibilities as required. Required Qualification High school diploma or equivalent Career Fire Fighter as defined by the New Hampshire State Fire Standards and Training Commission Training in Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) certification courses. Three to five years of experience in municipal, volunteer or industrial firefighting Successful completion of the Edison Electric Institute (EEI) Plant Operator Selection System (POSS) aptitude test required Preferred Qualification None Employee Group: Bargaining Unit Employee Type: Full Time Job Category: Craft Skilled/ Journey Level Organization: NextEra Energy Seabrook, LLC Location: Seabrook, New Hampshire Other Work Locations: New Hampshire Relocation Provided: No NextEra Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer. title: Sr Analyst Fundamental Analysis
descriptionText: Requisition ID: 40318 NextEra Energy Resources is one of the largest wholesale generators of electric power and renewable energy from the wind and sun in North America. Position Specific Description NextEra Energy Resources is actively seeking a talented individual offering expertise in the areas of electric generation resource planning and energy systems analysis to join our team. The Senior Analyst of Integrated Resource Planning is part of a highly skilled professional team and reports to the Manager of Integrated Resource Planning. The team is responsible for modeling of the electric system for various utilities throughout the US, providing insights into optimal generation resource mixes and quantifying the potential cost savings for varied resource plans. The team’s mission is to strategically and collaboratively plan the future of safe, reliable and competitively-priced energy for customer utilities. Be a part of the team that is literally planning the clean energy future. Senior Analyst responsibilities include but are not limited to: Performing Integrated Resource Planning (IRP) style generation planning and capacity expansion modeling using AuroraXMP (or similar) production costing software Researching IRPs from multiple entities as well as extracting key operational characteristics from FERC, EIA, EPA, Velocity, etc. to perform independent system analysis Developing proprietary modeling tools and methodologies to analyze evolving energy markets (including those managed by ISOs/RTOs) and their impact on NextEra’s businesses Analyzing market, historical, and fundamental data, drawing inferences and presenting results in a clear and understandable format to management and external customers Developing presentation materials that communicate clearly the analyses performed and conveying insights that help NextEra better serve its utility customers Assist in developing business case and alternatives analysis with cost-benefit and risk evaluation for future projects Support multiple ad hoc projects inclusive of those above, completing them in a timely manner The successful candidate must have five or more years of experience in related activities, including a strong understanding of the economics underlying electric power generation and a general sense for related technical issues. Previous experience in Integrated Resource Planning or a strong background in power sector modeling is required; experience with Aurora XMP or similar production cost models (PLEXOS, PROMOD, etc.) is preferred. A Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Business Administration, or related field is preferred; MBA or graduate degree also preferred. The successful candidate should have strong data management, analysis, and presentation skills (Excel, PowerPoint); some experience in evaluating complex technical and financial issues independently, developing recommendations, action plans, and managing multiple complex assignments simultaneously. title: Transmission Business Manager - NextEra
descriptionText: Requisition ID: 40356 NextEra Energy Resources is one of the largest wholesale generators of electric power and renewable energy from the wind and sun in North America. Position Specific Description The position will participate in regional internal interconnection feasibility studies and network upgrade cost estimate activities through the full life cycle of development and construction of projects leading to the successful execution of new asset growth across the respective region. As the experienced regional technical team member, the position is required to work with internal project developers/originators, and external entities including Regional Transmission Organization (RTO), Independent Systems Operators (ISO), Transmission Providers (TP), and Transmission Owners (TO) to review and evaluate interconnection standards and study practices, transmission siting feasibility, system impact studies, facility studies, and Large Generator Interconnection Agreement (LGIA). As the experienced regional technical team member, the positon’s roles is assisting NEER’s Development to determine optimal locations for the placement of renewable energy projects, verifying and challenging interconnection studies results, and negotiating to reach reasonable resolutions with ISOs and Transmission Providers. Job responsibilities are: • Proficiency in Transmission Providers’ tariff, business practices, interconnection standards, interconnection study practices, cost allocation methodologies, transmission planning standards, and transmission system performance evaluation criteria • Possess good understanding of regional transmission plans and operational practices • Configure and automate injection study systems • Perform injection studies to identify the optimal locations for the placement of generator resources across the respective region • Implement the optimal interconnection strategy • Perform the network upgrade cost estimates for the proposed projects • Verify and challenge System Impact and Facility Study results • Participate in negotiation with Transmission Providers to reach reasonable resolutions • Participate in negotiation of alternative low cost network upgrade solutions with transmission owner • Conduct Day One analyses to minimize curtailment by optimizing network upgrade construction scheduling, resolving transmission issues by investors, and supporting ISO’s Quarterly Operating Limit Studies or Limited Operation Interconnection Service studies Preferred Skills: • Commercially focused and detail oriented • Good communication skills and project management ability • Preferred technical background includes experience in transmission systems planning or generator interconnection process, and previous employment with a utility, or an ISO or a renewable energy company. Proficiency in power flow software, including PSSE/MUST, PowerWorld, and TARA, is required • A Bachelor degree in electrical engineering is required • An advanced degree in electrical engineering with a major in power systems is preferred • 5 to 7 years of experience in utility or ISO or RTO or energy industry is desired Job Overview Employees in this role supply solutions to technical transmission issues for development projects and current assets. The Project Finance Group is responsible for interfacing with debt and equity investors in the solar space – this includes ownership of relationships and transactions with investment banks, private equity firms, lenders, and corporate investors. The team performs detailed financial analysis of financing options, and negotiates and manages transaction closings. Additionally, the team manages significant cross-functional communication across sales, accounting, asset management, tax, and other functions to optimize financing strategy as well as to obtain necessary approvals for each transaction. The candidate should have experience with tax-incentivized finance structures, including leases and joint venture arrangements. Strong communication and analytical skills, and experience leading and closing transactions are expected, as is an understanding of relevant tax and GAAP regulations, contractual matters (including Power Purchase Agreements (“PPAs”)), analytic models (excel spreadsheets, lease pricing). Familiarity with the energy industry and finance providers in this industry segment is preferred. This position reports to the Senior Director of Project Finance, and closely coordinates efforts with Business Unit Leaders, In-House Counsel, the Treasury Group, and other team members. The Project Finance group is a lean team with a flat hierarchical structure, and the candidate must be willing to not only lead transactions and negotiations, but be highly involved in diligence, modeling, and all aspects of the deal closing process. Demonstrate comfort and prowess with project finance excel models Maintain and develop strategic relationships with finance providers, particularly “tax-equity” investors – understand investor strengths and limitations Work with in-house and external counsel to structure, negotiate, and close financing documentation Participate in the effective solicitation of financing proposals from the marketplace and ensure a fair and comprehensive bidding process Lead and be held accountable for successful transaction closings under tight deadlines Communicate with other departments including Sales, EPC, Accounting, Tax, Asset Management, and O&M on transaction details as well as business planning and work processes Provide consultative assistance and follow-up services on closed transactions as necessary Assist SunPower business units with the development of new channels of business Explore, recommend and lead improvements in work processes Track renewable energy markets, be aware of potential impacts on SunPower financing strategies Develop and implement improved financial structures MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS Education and Experience: Bachelor’s Degree in finance, accounting, engineering or other relevant fields, with at least 3 years of experience in project finance, leasing or equipment finance is required A deep understanding of the following is expected: Tax-Equity investor and investment experience Experience in equity and debt fundraising Understanding and negotiation of PPA’s, leases and other project financing legal arrangements Familiarity with solar financing structures including partnerships, leases, and secured debt structures Experience performing financial modeling and the understanding of financial concepts (ROI, IRR, NPV, MISF, WACC, etc...) descriptionText: Do you want to change the world? We do, too. With more than 30 years of proven experience, SunPower is a global leader in solar innovation and sustainability. SunPower is a company with a rich heritage of pioneering the best energy technologies in the world. You have the opportunity to join the company that helped establish solar markets around the world and continues to innovate in the renewable energy space. SunPower has facilities in the US, Europe and Asia, and we are seeking talented people to join us in building a clean energy future. Our unique approach emphasizes the seamless integration of advanced SunPower technologies, delivering complete solar solutions and lasting customer value. We are passionately committed to changing the way our world is powered, and we are guided by our legacy of innovation, optimism, perseverance, and integrity. Widely recognized as the world’s standard for solar, SunPower produces the world’s highest efficiency solar products. Our quality and reliability standards far exceed those of any other company in the industry. In order to unlock shareholder value, accelerate innovation and enhance customer value, SunPower will separate into two independent, publicly traded companies, strategically aligned and complementary, focusing on distinct offerings. Newly-formed Maxeon Solar Technologies will be the leading global technology innovator, manufacturer and marketer of premium solar panels, carrying on the decades’ long legacy in setting quality and performance standards. As we look to the future, we are seeking a world-class Lead Tax Accountant based in ROHQ, Binan, Philippines. In an industry that is reshaping the world’s energy future, there’s no better place to be than SunPower. Are you ready to change the way our world is powered? SUMMARY: SunPower is seeking a Lead Tax Accountant to help our tax team with various tax projects and ongoing tasks. The person will directly report to the SPES Tax Manager based in the Philippines and will support primarily on US sales and use taxation (SUT). The person will functionally report to the US SUT Manager/ Director. This position is a full-time opportunity. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following (other duties may be assigned): Support US sales and use tax compliance process for SunPower corporate and lease entities Support relationships with outside consultants and compliance provider Respond and resolve any state and local sales tax notices and inquiries Assist with sales and use tax audits and handle exemption certificates documentation Support transaction tax setups in Sabrix for US and Canada (act as Sabrix super user) Assist with research and due diligence to support various business initiatives Prepare reports, dashboards and documentations as needed Assist with monthly reconciliations and reviews of various GL accounts Assist with property tax issues as needed Other SUT related ad hoc tasks such as creation of POs, etc. Maintain good relationships and collaborate with various business units across the company. RELATED EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS Candidate must possess at least a Bachelor's/College Degree Finance/Accountancy/Banking or equivalent 3 to 4 year(s) of recent tax related work experience Certified Public Accountant eligibility is a plus Preferably with experience from any Big Four Firms Applicant must be willing to work in Sta. Rosa, Laguna Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) Ability to work with people in all departments of the company and from diverse cultural backgrounds Ability to think creatively and to complete tasks in a timely manner. Desire to work in a flexible “team-based” environment. Not afraid to “roll up the sleeves,” while being able to retain big picture thinking

Garantir a administração da infraestrutura de monitorização, mantendo-a estável, atualizada e ajustada; Conhecer a adequabilidade da monitorização do ponto de vista técnico (arquitetura, infraestrutura, componentes tecnológicas, etc.); funcional (processos suportados, funcionalidades, perfis, etc.) e contextual (relações com outras aplicações, sistemas, serviços e interfaces internas e externas, identificação e análise de riscos); Identificar medidas de melhoria e otimização que permitam potenciar o desempenho e serviço das infraestruturas e aplicações da EDP; Assumir a responsabilidade de cumprimento da política, normas, regras, processos e procedimentos de segurança de informação e continuidade de negócio que se aplicam às infraestruturas e aplicações da EDP; Garantir a existência e qualidade de informação/documentação atualizada sobre aplicações e/ou componentes da monitorização da EDP. title: Especialista em Regulação (Geração)
descriptionText: Missão: Tornar o seu apreço ao setor elétrico autêntico ao desenvolver soluções em assuntos regulatórios complexos e abrangentes, envolvendo usinas e geração de energia, através do monitoramento, liderança de projetos e processos, pareceres e outras atividades em atendimento às necessidades dos contratos de concessão e da regulação vigente, visando minimizar riscos, identificar oportunidades e proporcionar conformidade regulatória. Descrição: Monitorar e acompanhar a legislação do setor elétrico e seus impactos nas atividades da empresa, buscando identificar de forma antecipada riscos e oportunidades dentro dos limites regulatórios; Liderar projetos designados conforme complexidade e abrangência para atender as necessidades da empresa, contribuindo na formulação de estratégias e recomendações; Liderar o desenvolvimento de processos envolvendo questões hídricas, tais como o risco hidrológico e seus impactos, a qualidade dos serviços, insumos, disponibilidade de energia, e outros que afetam tais usinas de geração de energia, conforme definidos pelos atos de outorga; Liderar o desenvolvimento de processos envolvendo questões térmicas, tais como a definição de Custos Variáveis Unitários, a qualidade dos serviços, insumos, disponibilidade de energia, e outros que afetam tais usinas de geração de energia, conforme definidos pelos atos de outorga; Desenvolver, acompanhar e controlar indicadores de resultados, envolvendo processos de geração de energia e outros necessários para a tomada de decisão da Gestão, contribuindo para a manutenção da posição da empresa e o atendimento aos requisitos regulatórios definidos para cada negócio; Liderar o desenvolvimento de teses para a solução de problemas, pleitos ou defesa de posicionamento da empresa nos empreendimentos de geração, através das análises dos impactos, construção de teses e justificativas técnicas, de forma a demonstrar ao regulador o posicionamento adequado e as alterações necessárias, garantindo o melhor posicionamento da empresa e seus resultados; Pré-requisitos: Formação completa em Administração de Empresas, Economia, Engenharias ou Direito; Conhecer profundamente de assuntos regulatórios do setor elétrico. Inglês fluente; Desejável Pós-Graduação. Local de Trabalho: São Paulo, SP.

descriptionText: A EDP Soluções Comerciais está a recrutar para a Direção de Suporte às Operações. Esta Direção tem como principal missão assegurar o planeamento e controlo de gestão, a gestão de recursos humanos, de parceiros e de sistemas de informação, bem como os demais serviços de logística e de suporte às operações dos canais, em alinhamento com as políticas corporativas. Estamos a recrutar um/a: Gestor/a de Parceiros Descritivo da função: • Apoiar a gestão dos contratos de prestação de serviços, assegurando os mecanismos de validação e controlo dos volumes faturados e custos unitários; • Apurar o grau de realização dos níveis de serviço estabelecidos contratualmente com os parceiros e aplicar penalizações/bonificações de acordo com as regras definidas; • Validar a faturação dos PSE e realizar a liberação para pagamento; • Assegurar a contínua automatização e otimização dos processos de apuramento, análise e reporte de indicadores de performance e gestão operacional; • Produzir informação relevante sobre a atividade dos parceiros para reporte a clientes internos e externos; • Realizar a gestão administrativa dos contratos, através da normalização dos suportes contratuais, assegurando a sua permanente atualização (alterações contratuais e adendas); • Assegurar a manutenção de uma base de dados dos PSE (assegurando a sistematização da informação contratual e documentação anexa); • Realizar o tratamento e análise da informação de suporte à gestão, numa ótica administrativa e financeira, de todos os contratos com os fornecedores. Procuramos candidatos com o seguinte Perfil: • Licenciatura/Mestrado em Gestão, Economia, Informática aplicada à Gestão, Engenharia e Gestão Industrial ou outra desde que possua experiência relevante para a função; • Experiência profissional obrigatória superior a 1 ano, valorizando-se experiência na Área de Procurement, Gestão de Outsourcing ou Controlo de Gestão; • Competências de análise económico-financeira, controlo de gestão (obrigatório); • Técnicas de tratamento de análise de dados (obrigatório); • Valorizam-se conhecimentos de: - Conhecimento da regulação do sector - ERSE, RQS, RRC; - Conhecimento do mercado e da concorrência; -SAP, SAP IS-U, SAS, Power BI e conceitos básicos de Programação; • Domínio do Excel e Power Point; • Domínio do Português e Inglês. Local de trabalho: Lisboa O que oferecemos: • Contrato de trabalho sem termo; • Formação profissional inicial e contínua; • Vencimento compatível com a função e benefícios em vigor na empresa. Company : Black & Veatch Corporation Req Id : 15001 Job Title : Senior Project Manager-Houston-Water Business Line Location : RGHOUSTON Business Unit Sector : COR-WATER-WATER AMERICAS Opportunity Type : Staff Relocation eligible : No Full time/Part time : Full-Time Project Only Hire : No Visa Sponsorship Available: No Job Summary Black and Veatch is seeking an experienced Project Manager to join a well-established and expanding water/wastewater team in our Houston office. The Project Manager will be responsible for leading and managing the project team through planning, design and construction phases for a wide variety of municipal water and wastewater projects. The ideal candidate will be responsible for the day-to-day successful execution of contracted engineering, procurement, and construction scope in the areas of performance, financial metrics, planning, schedule, quality, contractual compliance, safety, and client satisfaction. The Project Manager is accountable for the execution of project scope, management of budget and schedule; development of strong relationships with clients, project teams, teaming partners and contractors; and drives business development. This role will offer a wide variety of individual project assignments which will allow the Project Manager to practice and develop technical knowledge and leadership skills. Black & Veatch is a leading engineering, consulting and construction company. We are employee-owned and have more than 100 offices worldwide. Our services in the Water market help to provide safe drinking water and effective wastewater management to communities. We serve public and private clients of every size with a strong focus on life cycle economy, efficiency and reliability. Key Responsibilities Serve as the manager of mulit-discipline project teams assuming management responsibilities of scope, budget and schedule. Manage project budgets, costs, and receivables. Analyze and report project financial metrics as a basis for improvement. Manage contracts and legal issues including third party subcontracts. Manage changes and risk on scope, cost, schedule, quality, and safety based on available resources and client requirements. Lead client, contractor, stakeholder, and regulatory agency meetings. Responsible for determining identification of key client interests and drivers on projects. Communicates client interests and drivers to project team members and develops approaches to accommodate these concerns in the performance of the work on complex projects. Focuses on client's current needs and situations. Typically manages multiple projects. Responsible for proposal preparation and pursuit of business development opportunities. Develop strong relationships with clients, project teams, teaming partners and contractors. Leverage professional networking skills to help identify and pursue project opportunities. Management Responsibilities Acts as a project manager. Among responsibilities is management of a project team. The individual comprising this team may vary by project.Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Civil, Mechanical or Environmental Engineering or a related field Prefer 10+ years professional experience managing a multi-disciplinary team to deliver water and wastewater design projects Previous consulting experience Proficiency with computer software, including MS Office Suite and Project Software Experience preparing proposals; negotiating and managing contracts; managing project budgets, costs and receivables Experience with planning, delegation, directing others and conflict management Experience dealing with ambiguity and building effective teams Knowledge of engineering design principles and applicable design guides and standards related to assigned engineering discipline Client Focus: Assist with identification of key client interests and drivers on complex projects Communicates client interests and drivers to project team members and develops approaches to accommodate these concerns in the performance of the work on complex projects Actively provide support to business development and development of strategies for client pursuit activities People Management - (supervision, career development, training, mentoring): Assist with performance management process, mentoring, recognition, and any corrective actions required Minimum Qualifications Bachelor of science degree. All applicants must be able to complete pre-employment onboarding requirements (if selected) which may include any/all of the following: criminal/civil background check, drug screen, and motor vehicle records search, in compliance with any applicable laws and regulations. Certifications None specified Work Environment/Physical Demands Typical office environment, typical construction environment, extreme weather conditions, high noise level, safety hazards (electric currents, working on scaffolding and high places, exposure to chemicals), atmospheric conditions (fumes, odors, dusts, mists, gases, poor ventilation). Sitting, walking, talking, hearing, reading, writing, keyboarding, driving, filing, reaching, stooping, crouching, bending, standing for extended periods of time, lifting or carrying up to 40 pounds.
